what: The Cigna Group is built around Evernorth, one of the three largest US pharmacy benefit managers, which negotiates drug prices for health plans and runs specialty and mail-order pharmacies. It also sells employer health insurance through Cigna Healthcare.
customers: Employers and health plans buying pharmacy benefits, and employers and individuals buying health insurance.
money: pharmacy benefit management, specialty pharmacy and care services
employer medical insurance in the US and international health cover
moat: Scale in drug purchasing that only two rivals match, and multi-year contracts with large employers that are disruptive to change.
risks: Politicians in both US parties have proposed restricting pharmacy benefit managers
Specialty drug costs, especially weight-loss medicines, pressure margins
Profit margin is about two cents on each revenue dollar
Losing one very large pharmacy contract moves results materially
opportunities: It exited Medicare Advantage, the part of the industry causing peers the most trouble
Weight-loss and specialty drugs push large volumes through Evernorth
Strong free cash flow funds large and continuing buybacks
watch: Evernorth adjusted operating income and the medical care ratio at Cigna Healthcare.
